summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Blue Light Phase 2 (bulk planning / allocation / duplicate protection / reassign) on contract CTR-BLFRS1 (b113a3cd…). Logged in via /api/crm/auth/login (owner@isodemo.com), set crm_token + crm_active_mode=business, opened Contracts -> contract -> Blue Light tab. ALL 5 requested behaviours PASS: (1) bl-plan-bar visible with bl-plan-date, bl-plan-window, bl-plan-engineer (8 options loaded from roster incl. 'Jordan Blake (2)' with planned-visit counts), bl-plan-btn, bl-reassign-btn, bl-select-all — all visible/enabled. (2) select-all + per-row bl-select-<site_id> checkboxes work (select-all -> '23 stations selected', untoggle -> 'Bulk plan visits'). (3) Filter status=Not Planned returned 45 rows; selected 3 (Bideford/Brixham/Bruton), date 2026-11-18, engineer Jordan Blake -> bl-plan-result shows 'Planned 3 visit(s) for the H2 2026 service cycle.', selection cleared, Scheduled tile 20->23 and awaiting booking 45->42; Bideford row flipped to Scheduled with Scheduled date 2026-11-18 and engineer 'Jordan Blake'. (4) Duplicate protection: re-planning the same 3 stations -> 'Planned 0 visit(s) for the H2 2026 service cycle. 3 skipped (duplicate protection): Bideford, Brixham, Bruton' + 're-select skipped' link. (5) Reassign: selected Bideford, picked 'TEST Staff 3707274e' -> 'Reassigned 1 visit(s) to TEST Staff 3707274e.' and the row Engineer cell updated. No JS runtime errors from BlueLightTab (only pre-existing 401/404 console noise from other CRM widgets).

minor.issue: Still 404s on every Contracts tab load (pre-existing, carried over from Phase 1) — console noise.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing space before the 're-select skipped' link — renders as 'Bruton Fire Stationre-select skipped'.
When every station is skipped the banner still leads with the green success line 'Planned 0 visit(s)…' with a check icon; a 0-created result should read as a warning, not a success.

Engineer option labels carry a planned-visit count e.g. 'Jordan Blake (2)' but the list is only fetched once on mount — after planning 3 visits the count is stale until a tab reload. Refetch /engineers inside refreshAll().
planVisits()/reassign() use window.alert() for validation ('Choose a scheduled date first.') and API errors — blocks the UI and is untestable/inconsistent with the app's toast pattern.

issues: Station matrix still needs horizontal scroll at 1920px — Visit/Calibration/Faults/Certificate columns are off-screen by default, so a user planning visits cannot see the resulting Visit-status pill without scrolling right (worse now that a checkbox column was added).
The outer-app 'Your session has expired' toast + cookie banner overlay the bottom of the matrix (known/ignorable).
No date validation: a past scheduled date is accepted by the UI without warning.

action_items: Add the missing space before the 're-select skipped' link in bl-plan-result.
Style the plan banner as a warning when created_count === 0 and all sites were skipped.
Refresh the engineer roster (planned_visits counts) after plan/reassign in refreshAll().
Replace alert() calls in planVisits/reassign with inline validation or the app toast.
Consider a sticky first column / condensed columns so the Visit + Engineer cells are visible without horizontal scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: BlueLightTab.js is 425 lines and now mixes overview, config, bulk planner and matrix — consider extracting the bulk-plan bar into its own component before Phase 3.

planVisits(force) is only ever called with force=false; the 're-select skipped' link just re-selects rows so the user must press Plan again, which will skip them again — either wire the link to planVisits(true) or rename it (currently a dead-end loop).
No client-side guard that scheduled_date >= today or <= service_window_end; the backend should be checked or a min attribute added to bl-plan-date.
seed_data_creation: Planned 3 real visits (Bideford / Brixham / Bruton Fire Stations, 2026-11-18, engineer Jordan Blake) on the seeded contract; Bideford then reassigned to 'TEST Staff 3707274e'. These created crm2_station_visits + svc_cases jobs — clean up if the demo needs the original 20-scheduled state. Seeded demo (blue_light_demo_v1) untouched otherwise.
test_credentials: CRM: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (POST /api/crm/auth/login, token -> localStorage 'crm_token', plus localStorage 'crm_active_mode'='business').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation recipe unchanged from Phase 1 (login via fetch, set crm_token + crm_active_mode=business, goto /crm?tab=contracts, click contract-row-b113a3cd-9998-434b-8bc4-a02e417eef91, click tab-bluelight). The first in-page fetch can throw 'Failed to fetch' — retry the login call a few times. After this run: Scheduled=23, Awaiting booking=42, 42 stations remain 'Not Planned'. The org roster contains several leftover 'TEST Staff <hex>' engineers from earlier test runs — they appear in bl-plan-engineer.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in Phase 2 frontend; only cosmetic/UX polish items listed above.
